notes.title: Enabled multi-capture
notes.content: Fixed so that you can capture multiple units in Tafl-games.

notes.title: Ludus
notes.content: Added the game Ludus latrunculorum. I am aware that multi-capture don't work. Hopefully, that will be fixed in the future.

notes.title: Sound FX
notes.content: Added sound on/off button and sound effects.

notes.title: Viking Chess
notes.content:
Added a new game type known as "Viking Chess" or "Hnefatafl".

Hnefatafl was a popular game in medieval Scandinavia and was mentioned in several of the Norse sagas.

notes.title: Chess
notes.content:
Added chess
AI is worse but the plan is to make it better for all games in the future.
